scripts.script:
-- Lilrabbi7416 Killaura + Bring GUI
local Whitelisted = {} 
local killauraEnabled = false
local bringEnabled = false
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function isWhitelisted(player)
for _, name in ipairs(Whitelisted) do
if name == player.Name then return true end
end
return false
end

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function getWeapon()
local char = LocalPlayer.Character
if not char then return nil end
for _, v in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
if v:FindFirstChild("WeaponHitEvent") then
return v end
end
return nil
end

local function optimizeWeapon(weapon)
pcall(function()
if weapon:GetAttribute("BaseCooldown") then weapon:SetAttribute("BaseCooldown", 0.25) end
if weapon:GetAttribute("AnimationTime") then
weapon:SetAttribute("AnimationTime", 0.35) end
         end)
end

local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SiriusSoftwareLtd/Rayfield/main/source.lua'))()

local function getClosestPlayer()
local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
if not myChar or not myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return nil end
local myRoot = myChar.HumanoidRootPart
local closest, dist = nil, 500
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character and not isWhitelisted(plr) then
local char = plr.Character
local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
if root and head then
local d = (myRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
if d < dist then
dist = d
closest = plr
end
end
end
end
return closest
end

-- Custom Loading Screen
Rayfield:Notify({
    Title = "made by Lilrabbi7416",
    Content = "Killaura + Bring loaded successfully",
    Duration = 6,
    Image = 4483362458,
})

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "Lilrabbi7416 Hub",
    LoadingTitle = "made by Lilrabbi7416",
    LoadingSubtitle = "Killaura + Bring",
    ConfigurationSaving = {
        Enabled = true,
        FolderName = "Lilrabbi7416",
        FileName = "KillauraConfig"
    }
})

local MainTab = Window:CreateTab("Main", 4483362458)
local WhitelistTab = Window:CreateTab("Whitelist", 4483362458)

local killauraConnection
local function startKillaura()
if killauraConnection then return end
killauraConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
if not killauraEnabled then return end
local weapon = getWeapon()
if not weapon then return end
optimizeWeapon(weapon)
local remote = weapon:FindFirstChild("WeaponHitEvent")
if not remote then return end
local target = getClosestPlayer()
if not target or not target.Character then return end
local hitPart = target.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
if hitPart then remote:FireServer(hitPart) end
end)
end

MainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Killaura (Auto Fire)",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "KillauraToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        killauraEnabled = Value
        if Value then
            startKillaura()
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Killaura", Content = "Enabled - Attacking closest player", Duration = 4})
        else
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Killaura", Content = "Disabled", Duration = 4})
        end
    end,
})

local bringConnection
local function startBring()
if bringConnection then return end
bringConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
if not bringEnabled then return end
local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
if not myChar or not myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
local myRoot = myChar.HumanoidRootPart.Position
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(myRoot + Vector3.new(math.random(-5,5), 0, math.random(-5,5)))
end
end
end)
end

WhitelistTab:CreateParagraph({Title = "Whitelist System", Content = "Whitelisted players will NOT be attacked by Killaura."})

local PlayerDropdown
local function refreshPlayerList()
local playerNames = {}
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if plr ~= LocalPlayer then table.insert(playerNames, plr.Name) end
end
return playerNames
end

PlayerDropdown = WhitelistTab:CreateDropdown({
    Name = "Select Player",
    Options = refreshPlayerList(),
    CurrentOption = {},
    MultipleOptions = false,
    Flag = "PlayerSelect",
    Callback = function() end,
})

WhitelistTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Whitelist Selected Player",
    Callback = function()
        local selected = PlayerDropdown.CurrentOption[1]
        if selected and not table.find(Whitelisted, selected) then
            table.insert(Whitelisted, selected)
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Whitelist", Content = selected .. " has been whitelisted", Duration = 4})
        end
    end,
})

MainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Bring Everyone (Client-Sided)",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "BringToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        bringEnabled = Value
        if Value then
            startBring()
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Bring", Content = "Everyone is now being pulled to you (client only)", Duration = 5})
        else
            Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Bring", Content = "Disabled", Duration = 4})
        end
    end,
})

WhitelistTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Unwhitelist Selected Player",
    Callback = function()
        local selected = PlayerDropdown.CurrentOption[1]
        if selected then
            for i, name in ipairs(Whitelisted) do
                if name == selected then
                    table.remove(Whitelisted, i)
                    Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Whitelist", Content = selected .. " has been removed", Duration = 4})
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end,
})

WhitelistTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Refresh Player List",
    Callback = function() PlayerDropdown:Refresh(refreshPlayerList()) end,
})

WhitelistTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Clear All Whitelist",
    Callback = function()
        Whitelisted = {}
        Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Whitelist", Content = "All players unwhitelisted", Duration = 4})
    end,
})

print("Lilrabbi7416 Hub loaded successfully!")

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local gui = nil
local connection = nil
local isEnabled = false

local function getSyncPairs(realObj, cloneObj, pairsTable)
    if realObj:IsA("BasePart") and cloneObj:IsA("BasePart") then
        cloneObj.Anchored = true
        table.insert(pairsTable, {real = realObj, clone = cloneObj})
    end
    
    local realChildren = realObj:GetChildren()
    local cloneChildren = cloneObj:GetChildren()

    local cloneMap = {}
    for _, child in ipairs(cloneChildren) do
        local key = child.Name .. child.ClassName
        if not cloneMap[key] then cloneMap[key] = {} end
        table.insert(cloneMap[key], child)
    end
    for _, child in ipairs(realChildren) do
        local key = child.Name .. child.ClassName
        if cloneMap[key] and #cloneMap[key] > 0 then
            local matchedClone = table.remove(cloneMap[key], 1)
            getSyncPairs(child, matchedClone, pairsTable)
        end
    end
end

local function togglePerfectGreenScreen()
    isEnabled = not isEnabled
    
    if isEnabled then
        local character = player.Character
        if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            isEnabled = false
            return
        end
        
        gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name = "PerfectChromaKey"
        gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        gui.DisplayOrder = 99999
        local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
        bg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        bg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
        bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
        bg.Parent = gui
        
        local vpf = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
        vpf.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        vpf.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        vpf.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)  Keeps the character well-lit
        vpf.Parent = bg
        
        local vpfCamera = Instance.new("Camera")
        vpf.CurrentCamera = vpfCamera
        vpfCamera.Parent = vpf
        

        character.Archivable = true
        local clone = character:Clone()

        for _, desc in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
            if desc:IsA("Script") or desc:IsA("LocalScript") then
                desc:Destroy()
            end
        end
        local syncPairs = {}
        getSyncPairs(character, clone, syncPairs)
        
        clone.Parent = vpf
        gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    
        connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()

            if not player.Character or not player.Character.Parent then
                togglePerfectGreenScreen()
                return
            end
            

            vpfCamera.CFrame = camera.CFrame
            vpfCamera.FieldOfView = camera.FieldOfView
            
            for _, pair in ipairs(syncPairs) do
                if pair.real and pair.clone and pair.real.Parent then
                    pair.clone.CFrame = pair.real.CFrame
                end
            end
        end)
        
    else

        if connection then
            connection:Disconnect()
            connection = nil
        end
        if gui then
            gui:Destroy()
            gui = nil
        end
    end
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F3 then
        togglePerfectGreenScreen()
    end
end)

local function HXRD_fake_script() -- passpage.Dragify 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', passpage)

	local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	
	local gui = script.Parent
	
	local dragging
	local dragInput
	local dragStart
	local startPos
	
	local function update(input)
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		gui.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
	
	gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = gui.Position
	
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	
	gui.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragInput = input
		end
	end)
	
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input == dragInput and dragging then
			update(input)
		end
	end)
end
coroutine.wrap(HXRD_fake_script)()
